findings.text: blocking: the fragment records processed PSRC magPbTC18 as raw MDAC magPbTC18 with unique=yes and counts i=18 in the "18 of 23" identity set, but its own row at :136 gives slope -4.19704 and Pearson r -0.97719 at runner-up ratio 1.151, an anti-correlated near-duplicate rather than an identity, so the conclusion at :215 that magPbTC1..18 is raw MDAC magPbTC1..18 (identity) is overstated for i=18 and would mislead the binding node.

follow-on: the S007 section states every channel's runner-up ratio is near 1, but the table rows at :84-111 show five channels above 10 (up to 25.328) and thirteen below 3, so the ratio characterisation is contradicted by the table; the supported reason all 27 fail to resolve is that every channel best-matches the same loop magFluxP7, which the table does show.

follow-on: all 44 sensors join their nearest description loop or probe at exactly 0.0 mm, which indicates the section-4 description R,Z derive from the same SELENE source as the codex receipt, so the join is a provenance match rather than the independent corroboration the wording implies, and the run should show the check would see a non-zero distance for a displaced position.
